$comment: Phrases users call a skill with, for scripts/routing.mjs. Written the way people talk in chat, not as a quote of the description: a quote only checks that a text equals itself. Russian phrases stay (Russian is a full second language of the plugin); every skill also has at least one English phrase. expect is the skill that must land in the top K; not lists skills that must not come first with a weight above noiseFloor. A failed phrase means fix the description first. Manual skills (disable-model-invocation) are absent: the model does not see their description.
